## Direct Answer

The mobile push notification opt-in rate for new installs has dropped noticeably over the past several days (tracked as **INC1257**, currently in "Investigating" status). The leading theory — from both the Product team and mobile engineering — is that a recent change to permission-prompt timing (moving the prompt later in the app flow) is responsible, but **this has not been confirmed**. No root cause, fix, or resolution has been recorded yet, and the team has proposed running an A/B test to confirm the cause before making any changes.

In this Slack thread, Sam Okafor flags that "push opt-in rate for new installs is down noticeably the last few days." A mobile-team member recalls that the permission prompt was recently moved later in the flow, and Sam agrees timing "might be related" but again stresses "not confirmed yet though, could be something else entirely." The thread ends with a suggestion to run an A/B test to confirm the cause before reverting the change — no such test result appears in the graph yet.

In short: this is an **open, unconfirmed incident** — the timing-change hypothesis is the leading suspect, but as of the last update, it remains unverified and the ticket is still in active investigation.
